queries.name: wa_summary
queries.description: 홈 KPI 요약 — 학생/기관/이번 달 수업/검사/상담/미발송 리포트
queries.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students) AS students,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organizations) AS orgs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule WHERE class_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND class_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month') AS classes_month,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_sessions) AS tests,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counseling_sessions) AS counsel,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parent_reports WHERE sent_date IS NULL) AS unsent

queries.name: wa_home_schedule
queries.sql:
SELECT cs.class_date, cs.start_time, s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name, cs.status
FROM class_schedule cs
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = cs.student_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cs.subject_id
WHERE cs.class_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 days' AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY cs.class_date, cs.start_time
LIMIT 50

queries.name: wa_home_attention
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name, cur.unit_name, pt.progress_percent AS progress_pct
FROM progress_tracking pt
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = pt.student_id
LEFT JOIN curriculum cur ON cur.id = pt.curriculum_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cur.subject_id
WHERE COALESCE(pt.progress_percent, 0) < 70
ORDER BY COALESCE(pt.progress_percent, 0) ASC
LIMIT 20

queries.name: wa_home_drafts
queries.sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(to_char(pr.report_period_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || to_char(pr.report_period_end, 'MM-DD'), pr.report_type) AS report_period,
  s.name AS student_name,
  pr.created_at,
  pr.status
FROM parent_reports pr
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = pr.student_id
WHERE pr.sent_date IS NULL
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20

queries.name: wa_home_orgs
queries.sql:
SELECT o.name, o.org_type, o.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.org_id = o.id) AS student_count
FROM organizations o
ORDER BY o.name
LIMIT 20

queries.name: wa_orgs
queries.sql:
SELECT o.name, o.org_type, o.region, o.cohort, o.status,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.org_id = o.id) AS student_count
FROM organizations o
ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: wa_onboard
queries.description: 기관 온보딩 진행 — 간이 집계 (학생/계약정보/연락처/시작일 기준)
queries.sql:
SELECT
  o.name, o.org_type,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.org_id = o.id) AS student_count,
  ((CASE WHEN o.contact_name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   + (CASE WHEN o.contact_phone IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   + (CASE WHEN o.contact_email IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   + (CASE WHEN o.program_name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   + (CASE WHEN o.cohort IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   + (CASE WHEN o.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   + (CASE WHEN o.student_quota IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
   + (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.org_id = o.id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS done_steps,
  ROUND(100.0 *
    ((CASE WHEN o.contact_name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN o.contact_phone IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN o.contact_email IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN o.program_name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN o.cohort IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN o.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN o.student_quota IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.org_id = o.id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) / 8.0, 0) AS progress_pct
FROM organizations o
ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: wa_schedule
queries.sql:
SELECT cs.class_date, cs.start_time, s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name, cs.topic, cs.status
FROM class_schedule cs
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = cs.student_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cs.subject_id
WHERE cs.class_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY cs.class_date DESC, cs.start_time
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_homework
queries.sql:
SELECT h.due_date, s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name, h.title, h.status, h.score
FROM homework h
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = h.student_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = h.subject_id
ORDER BY h.due_date DESC NULLS LAST, h.id DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_students
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name, s.student_code, s.grade, s.school AS school_name,
  (SELECT o.name FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = s.org_id) AS org_name,
  s.learning_style
FROM students s
ORDER BY s.name

queries.name: wa_progress
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name, cur.unit_name,
  pt.progress_percent AS progress_pct, pt.mastery_score AS achievement, pt.updated_at AS last_updated
FROM progress_tracking pt
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = pt.student_id
LEFT JOIN curriculum cur ON cur.id = pt.curriculum_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cur.subject_id
ORDER BY pt.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_tutor
queries.sql:
SELECT ai.session_date, s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name,
  ai.session_type, ai.duration_minutes AS duration_min, ai.student_engagement AS engagement
FROM ai_tutor_sessions ai
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = ai.student_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = ai.subject_id
ORDER BY ai.session_date DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_contents
queries.sql:
SELECT lc.title, sub.subject_name, lc.content_type, lc.difficulty, lc.estimated_minutes AS duration_min
FROM learning_contents lc
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = lc.subject_id
ORDER BY lc.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_books
queries.sql:
SELECT pr.title, pr.provider AS publisher, sub.subject_name,
  pr.target AS target_grade, pr.level AS difficulty
FROM prescription_resources pr
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = pr.subject_id
WHERE pr.resource_type IN ('교재', '도서', '문제집')
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_qbank
queries.sql:
SELECT sub.subject_name, cur.unit_name, qb.question_type, qb.difficulty, qb.usage_count
FROM question_bank qb
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = qb.subject_id
LEFT JOIN curriculum cur ON cur.id = qb.curriculum_id
ORDER BY qb.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_prescription
queries.description: 학습 처방 — 상담 세션의 처방 기록(학생별)
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name,
  NULL::text AS subject_name,
  cs.session_date AS issued_date,
  LEFT(COALESCE(cs.prescription, ''), 80) AS focus_area,
  cs.status
FROM counseling_sessions cs
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = cs.student_id
WHERE cs.prescription IS NOT NULL AND cs.prescription <> ''
ORDER BY cs.session_date DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_paths
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name, lp.path_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_path_steps lps WHERE lps.path_id = lp.id) AS step_count,
  lp.status
FROM learning_paths lp
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = lp.student_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = lp.subject_id
ORDER BY lp.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_weak
queries.description: 취약 단원(진도<70 또는 성취<70) — progress_tracking 기준
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name, cur.unit_name,
  pt.progress_percent AS progress_pct, pt.mastery_score AS achievement
FROM progress_tracking pt
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = pt.student_id
LEFT JOIN curriculum cur ON cur.id = pt.curriculum_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cur.subject_id
WHERE COALESCE(pt.progress_percent, 0) < 70 OR COALESCE(pt.mastery_score, 0) < 70
ORDER BY COALESCE(pt.progress_percent, 0) + COALESCE(pt.mastery_score, 0) ASC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_tests
queries.sql:
SELECT ts.test_date, s.name AS student_name, ts.test_type,
  COALESCE(ts.overall_label, LEFT(COALESCE(ts.summary, ''), 60)) AS result_summary
FROM test_sessions ts
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = ts.student_id
ORDER BY ts.test_date DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_grades
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name, sg.school_year, sg.semester, sg.subject_name,
  NULL::numeric AS score, sg.grade AS grade_level
FROM school_grades sg
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = sg.student_id
ORDER BY sg.school_year DESC, sg.semester DESC, s.name, sg.subject_name
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_roadmap
queries.sql:
SELECT s.name AS student_name,
  at.university || COALESCE(' · ' || at.department, '') AS target_name,
  rs.id AS step_order,
  COALESCE(rs.category || ' · ', '') || rs.title AS step_name,
  COALESCE(rs.school_year::text || '학년 ' || rs.semester::text || '학기',
           to_char(rs.target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS due_period,
  rs.status
FROM admission_roadmap_steps rs
LEFT JOIN admission_targets at ON at.id = rs.target_id
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = rs.student_id
ORDER BY s.name, at.priority NULLS LAST, rs.target_date NULLS LAST, rs.id
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_rx_res
queries.sql:
SELECT pr.title, sub.subject_name, pr.resource_type, pr.target AS target_level
FROM prescription_resources pr
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = pr.subject_id
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_counsel
queries.sql:
SELECT cs.session_date, s.name AS student_name, cs.topic AS session_type,
  cs.counselor AS counselor_name, LEFT(COALESCE(cs.content, ''), 80) AS summary
FROM counseling_sessions cs
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = cs.student_id
ORDER BY cs.session_date DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_reports
queries.sql:
SELECT
  pr.id,
  COALESCE(to_char(pr.report_period_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || to_char(pr.report_period_end, 'MM-DD'), pr.report_type) AS report_period,
  s.name AS student_name,
  pr.created_at,
  pr.sent_date AS sent_at,
  pr.status
FROM parent_reports pr
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = pr.student_id
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

queries.name: wa_search
queries.sql:
(SELECT 'student' AS kind, s.id::text AS ref_id, s.name AS title,
   COALESCE(s.student_code,'') || ' · ' || COALESCE(s.school,'') || ' · ' || COALESCE(s.grade,'') AS subtitle,
   NULL::date AS as_of
 FROM students s
 WHERE s.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(s.student_code,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(s.school,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'org' AS kind, o.id::text, o.name,
   COALESCE(o.org_type,'') || ' · ' || COALESCE(o.region,'') AS subtitle,
   NULL::date
 FROM organizations o
 WHERE o.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(o.region,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'test' AS kind, t.id::text,
   s.name || ' · ' || COALESCE(t.test_type,'') AS title,
   COALESCE(t.overall_label, LEFT(COALESCE(t.summary,''),40)) AS subtitle,
   t.test_date
 FROM test_sessions t LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = t.student_id
 WHERE COALESCE(t.test_type,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(t.test_name,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
   OR COALESCE(t.summary,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR s.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'counsel' AS kind, c.id::text,
   s.name || ' · ' || COALESCE(c.topic,'상담') AS title,
   LEFT(COALESCE(c.content,''),50) AS subtitle,
   c.session_date
 FROM counseling_sessions c LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = c.student_id
 WHERE COALESCE(c.content,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR COALESCE(c.topic,'') ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR s.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
ORDER BY kind, as_of DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

queries.name: wa_stu_basic
queries.sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_code, s.grade, s.school,
  o.name AS org_name, o.org_type,
  s.parent_name, s.parent_phone, s.parent_email,
  s.learning_style, s.learning_goal, s.status, s.enrolled_date
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
WHERE s.id = $1

queries.name: wa_stu_recent
queries.description: 학생 요약 — 최근 수업+숙제 통합 타임라인
queries.sql:
(SELECT '수업' AS kind, cs.class_date AS d, sub.subject_name AS subject,
   COALESCE(cs.topic, '') AS title, COALESCE(cs.attendance, cs.status) AS status, NULL::numeric AS score
 FROM class_schedule cs
 LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cs.subject_id
 WHERE cs.student_id = $1
 ORDER BY cs.class_date DESC
 LIMIT 10)
UNION ALL
(SELECT '숙제' AS kind, h.due_date, sub.subject_name,
   h.title, h.status, h.score
 FROM homework h
 LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = h.subject_id
 WHERE h.student_id = $1
 ORDER BY h.due_date DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 10)
ORDER BY d DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

queries.name: wa_stu_progress
queries.sql:
SELECT sub.subject_name, cur.unit_name,
  pt.progress_percent AS progress_pct, pt.mastery_score AS achievement, pt.updated_at
FROM progress_tracking pt
LEFT JOIN curriculum cur ON cur.id = pt.curriculum_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cur.subject_id
WHERE pt.student_id = $1
ORDER BY pt.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

queries.name: wa_stu_tests
queries.sql:
SELECT t.id, t.test_date, t.test_type, t.test_name,
  t.overall_label, t.overall_index, LEFT(COALESCE(t.summary,''),120) AS summary
FROM test_sessions t
WHERE t.student_id = $1
ORDER BY t.test_date DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

queries.name: wa_stu_grades
queries.sql:
SELECT sg.school_year, sg.semester, sg.subject_name, sg.achievement, sg.grade, sg.exam_period
FROM school_grades sg
WHERE sg.student_id = $1
ORDER BY sg.school_year DESC, sg.semester DESC, sg.subject_name

queries.name: wa_stu_roadmap
queries.description: 학생 요약 — 진학 목표 + 로드맵 단계
queries.sql:
SELECT at.id AS target_id, at.university, at.department, at.admission_type,
  at.target_year, at.required_grade, at.priority, at.status AS target_status,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admission_roadmap_steps rs WHERE rs.target_id = at.id) AS step_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admission_roadmap_steps rs WHERE rs.target_id = at.id AND rs.status = '완료') AS done_steps
FROM admission_targets at
WHERE at.student_id = $1
ORDER BY at.priority NULLS LAST, at.id

queries.name: wa_stu_counsel
queries.sql:
SELECT c.session_date, c.counselor, c.topic,
  LEFT(COALESCE(c.content,''),140) AS content_preview,
  LEFT(COALESCE(c.prescription,''),120) AS prescription_preview,
  c.next_date, c.status
FROM counseling_sessions c
WHERE c.student_id = $1
ORDER BY c.session_date DESC
LIMIT 10

queries.name: wa_stu_reports
queries.description: 학생 요약 — 학부모 리포트 발행 현황
queries.sql:
SELECT pr.id, pr.report_period_start, pr.report_period_end, pr.report_type,
  pr.status, pr.sent_date, pr.created_at
FROM parent_reports pr
WHERE pr.student_id = $1
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20

queries.name: wa_students_pick
queries.description: 학생 셀렉터 — 전체 학생 간단 리스트
queries.sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.grade, s.school, o.name AS org_name
FROM students s LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
ORDER BY s.name

queries.name: wa_orgs_pick
queries.sql:
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.org_type, o.region, o.status,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.org_id = o.id) AS student_count
FROM organizations o
ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: wa_org_detail
queries.sql:
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.org_type, o.region, o.address,
  o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.contact_email,
  o.program_name, o.cohort, o.status, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.student_quota, o.note,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.org_id = o.id) AS student_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule cs JOIN students s ON s.id = cs.student_id
     WHERE s.org_id = o.id AND cs.class_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
     AND cs.class_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month') AS classes_month,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counseling_sessions c JOIN students s ON s.id = c.student_id
     WHERE s.org_id = o.id AND c.session_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') AS counsel_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parent_reports pr JOIN students s ON s.id = pr.student_id
     WHERE s.org_id = o.id AND pr.sent_date IS NULL) AS unsent_reports
FROM organizations o
WHERE o.id = $1

queries.name: wa_org_students
queries.description: 기관 상세 — 소속 학생 전원 요약
queries.sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_code, s.grade, s.school, s.learning_style,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_sessions t WHERE t.student_id = s.id) AS test_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counseling_sessions c WHERE c.student_id = s.id) AS counsel_count,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(pt.progress_percent,0))) FROM progress_tracking pt WHERE pt.student_id = s.id) AS avg_progress,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parent_reports pr WHERE pr.student_id = s.id AND pr.sent_date IS NULL) AS unsent
FROM students s
WHERE s.org_id = $1
ORDER BY s.name

queries.name: wa_home_recent_classes
queries.sql:
SELECT cs.class_date, cs.start_time, s.name AS student_name, sub.subject_name,
  COALESCE(cs.topic,'') AS topic, cs.status
FROM class_schedule cs
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = cs.student_id
LEFT JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id = cs.subject_id
ORDER BY ABS(cs.class_date - CURRENT_DATE) ASC, cs.start_time
LIMIT 10

queries.name: wa_subjects
queries.sql: SELECT id, subject_name FROM subjects ORDER BY id

queries.name: wa_m_hw_score
queries.sql:
UPDATE homework SET score = $2, status = $3, submitted_at = CASE WHEN $3 = '제출' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE submitted_at END
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, score, status

queries.name: wa_m_cls_att
queries.sql:
UPDATE class_schedule SET attendance = $2, status = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('출석','지각','조퇴') THEN '완료' WHEN $2 = '결석' THEN '결석' ELSE status END
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, attendance, status

queries.name: wa_m_counsel_add
queries.sql:
INSERT INTO counseling_sessions (student_id, session_date, counselor, topic, content, prescription, next_date, status)
VALUES ($1, COALESCE(to_date(NULLIF($2,''),'YYYY-MM-DD'), CURRENT_DATE), $3, $4, $5, $6, to_date(NULLIF($7,''),'YYYY-MM-DD'), '완료')
RETURNING id

queries.name: wa_m_report_send
queries.sql:
UPDATE parent_reports SET sent_date = CURRENT_DATE, status = '발송'
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, sent_date, status

queries.name: wa_stu_roadmap_steps
queries.description: 학생 요약 — 목표별 로드맵 단계 전체(완료 체크용)
queries.sql:
SELECT rs.id, rs.target_id, at.university, at.department,
  rs.school_year, rs.semester, rs.category, rs.title,
  rs.target_date, rs.status
FROM admission_roadmap_steps rs
LEFT JOIN admission_targets at ON at.id = rs.target_id
WHERE rs.student_id = $1
ORDER BY at.priority NULLS LAST, at.id, rs.target_date NULLS LAST, rs.id

queries.name: wa_m_step_toggle
queries.sql:
UPDATE admission_roadmap_steps
SET status = $2
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, status

queries.name: wa_m_target_add
queries.sql:
INSERT INTO admission_targets (student_id, university, department, admission_type, target_year, required_grade, priority, status, note)
VALUES ($1, $2, NULLIF($3,''), NULLIF($4,''),
  CASE WHEN $5 ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN $5::int ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN $6 ~ '^[0-9.]+$' THEN $6::numeric ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN $7 ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN $7::int ELSE 3 END,
  '검토', NULLIF($8,''))
RETURNING id

queries.name: wa_report_one
queries.description: 리포트 — 단일 리포트 전체 필드 조회(수정 모달용)
queries.sql:
SELECT pr.id, pr.student_id, s.name AS student_name,
  pr.report_period_start, pr.report_period_end, pr.report_type,
  pr.overall_progress, pr.attendance_summary, pr.assessment_summary,
  pr.strengths, pr.areas_for_improvement, pr.teacher_comments,
  pr.ai_summary, pr.next_period_goals, pr.status, pr.sent_date
FROM parent_reports pr
LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = pr.student_id
WHERE pr.id = $1

queries.name: wa_m_report_add
queries.sql:
INSERT INTO parent_reports (student_id, report_period_start, report_period_end, report_type,
  overall_progress, strengths, areas_for_improvement, teacher_comments, next_period_goals, status)
VALUES ($1,
  COALESCE(to_date(NULLIF($2,''),'YYYY-MM-DD'), date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date),
  COALESCE(to_date(NULLIF($3,''),'YYYY-MM-DD'), (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date),
  NULLIF($4,''),
  NULLIF($5,''), NULLIF($6,''), NULLIF($7,''), NULLIF($8,''), NULLIF($9,''),
  '초안')
RETURNING id

queries.name: wa_m_report_update
queries.description: 쓰기 — 학부모 리포트 수정(초안 상태만 가능)
queries.sql:
UPDATE parent_reports
SET report_period_start = COALESCE(to_date(NULLIF($2,''),'YYYY-MM-DD'), report_period_start),
    report_period_end = COALESCE(to_date(NULLIF($3,''),'YYYY-MM-DD'), report_period_end),
    report_type = COALESCE(NULLIF($4,''), report_type),
    overall_progress = NULLIF($5,''),
    strengths = NULLIF($6,''),
    areas_for_improvement = NULLIF($7,''),
